periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 75 to 85 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, with a slight inward tilt toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the vertical dimension is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering; the lowest point is significantly shifted below the geometric center, extending toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick lateral profile, occupying approximately one-third of the visible upper torso height at the shoulder junction.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation; the gap between the medial edges is approximately twice the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semicircular curvature with no visible flattening at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brown/sepia-toned discoloration of the fur across the ventral abdominal region and lower limbs.
